title: Synthetic network-societies batch 2 statements
description: Pilot groups copied verbatim, plus campaign-local statements for the abortion forum, gender conduct, and voting. Accepted bridge wording is not copied here.
notes: Synthetic campaign only. Do not copy these into seed-content/.

Groups crypto-merchants, civic-assimilation, christian-teaching, home-learning, and shared-goods are copied from network-societies-v1-pilot-statements.json so this collection can load on its own. Edit those texts in the pilot file and re-copy; do not rewrite them here.

groups.title: Crypto-friendly merchant trials in Owen Sound

statements.text: I want six named shops in Owen Sound, Ontario, to be able to try a checkout that takes a crypto payment and can refund it, for a three-month trial.
I want the Owen Sound crypto-checkout trial to publish every fee, failed payment, and refund from those three months.
I want an independent reviewer to publish the security findings in the Owen Sound trial checkout, including findings the shops have not yet fixed.
I want a directory of Owen Sound shops in the checkout trial that says which shops are still taking the payment and which shops stopped.
I want a quarterly Saturday clinic in Owen Sound where a shop can run one test sale on the trial checkout and leave with a written result.
I want a written host kit so a second person can run the next Owen Sound checkout clinic without the first host.
I want every shop in the Owen Sound crypto trial to keep taking cash and ordinary cards for the whole three months.
I want shops in Owen Sound to refuse customer payments in crypto.
I want a willing Owen Sound shop and a willing customer to be able to complete a payment when a bank has blocked that customer.
I want the Owen Sound trial checkout to show the fee for a twenty-dollar sale before the customer pays.

groups.title: Shared civic life in Grey County

statements.text: I want twelve practical English conversation sessions in Owen Sound, Ontario, with childcare in the room, for newcomers and long-time residents together.
I want a reusable pack that explains, in plain English, how a person in Grey County uses the library, the bus, a school meeting, and a township office.
I want one summer of newcomers and long-time residents repairing paths in Harrison Park, Owen Sound, with the hours and costs published at the end.
I want the Grey County language-tutor listings checked by someone who does not run the sessions, including a public note when a listing fails the check.
I want a written handoff so a second organizer can run the next Owen Sound conversation session without the first organizer.
I want township business in Grey County to stay in English, including when language classes are offered.
I want newcomers in Grey County to be able to keep their own language communities without a public program that expects them to adopt local customs.
I want Grey County to stop recruiting more newcomers until the published housing and clinic wait times get shorter.
I want the Owen Sound bus terminal and library to post, in the languages already spoken in town, where the conversation sessions meet.
I want the Owen Sound conversation sessions to teach practical English, and I want them to stop short of telling newcomers which customs to keep.

groups.title: Christian teaching resources in Grey County

statements.text: I want the teaching notes for one Grey County congregation's midweek class released so another congregation can reuse them.
I want the recordings of that Grey County midweek class transcribed for people who cannot hear them.
I want a published rota and sermon notes so a substitute can preach at a named Grey County church when the regular preacher is away for one season.
I want shared Grey County teaching notes to name the confession they come from.
I want congregations that reuse the same Grey County teaching notes to stop short of publishing a joint statement of doctrine.
I want a one-season host kit so a second Grey County church can run the substitute-preacher rota after the first season.
I want to help transcribe public civic materials in Grey County, and I do not want that work to include church teaching.
I want a congregation's teaching notes to stay inside that congregation.
I want a public calendar of which Grey County church is short a preacher on which Sunday this season.
I want one open grade-six science unit, with materials a Grey County home-school family can print.
I want the permission form, map, and safety notes for one Grey County field trip released so another family can run the same trip.
I want instructions for a home science kit that uses ordinary store items, written so a Grey County family can repeat it.
I want eight Saturday meetups in Owen Sound for home-school families, with the dates published before the first meeting.
I want a named successor, and written notes, so the Owen Sound home-school meetups can continue for a second season without the first host.
I want each Grey County home-school unit to say which teaching method it uses.
I want a Grey County science unit that contains no religious claims, so a secular home-school family can use it.
I want families whose children attend school in Grey County to be allowed to use the same field-trip notes.
I want children in Grey County taught in staffed schools, and I do not want public rooms booked for home-school programs.
I want the Grey County home science kit to list the hazards and the adult supervision each activity needs.

groups.title: Goods reused across Grey County boards

statements.text: I want a public directory of people in Grey County, Ontario, who will host a small class, with each host's affiliation written down and a note when an independent checker has confirmed the listing.

groups.title: Michigan abortion authority, beside the accepted cutoff
notes: These are separate wants. None of them is an implication of the accepted 12-16 week settlement.
Do not give these statements bridge roles.

statements.text: I want Michigan's legislature, rather than a federal statute, to decide whether abortion is legal in Michigan.
I want one federal statute to set the abortion rule for every US state, including Michigan.
I want people in Michigan to keep campaigning for the abortion law they prefer, rather than accepting a cutoff neither side likes.
I want abortion forbidden in Michigan from the start of pregnancy, including during the first 12 weeks.

I want a written comparison of three Michigan proposals — a 12-16 week cutoff, a ban from the start of pregnancy, and no cutoff — that labels each one as a proposal and does not say which rule is in force.
I want a written checklist a moderator can use to publish a meeting's question, the statements under discussion, and the notes, without claiming the meeting decided a law.

groups.title: Grey County school conduct, separate from the schools-pushing bridge
notes: The accepted LGBT-schools statements are about pushing versus support. They do not settle medical treatment, adult speech, or classroom names. These statements do not use bridge roles.

statements.text: I want one Grey County school to publish the steps a student uses to report harassment, and to apply those steps without requiring the student to agree with a classmate.
I want any drug or surgery offered to a minor in Grey County as a gender treatment to require a licensed clinician outside the school, not a decision by school staff.
I want Grey County schools to stay out of approving drugs or surgery for students.
I want a Grey County school counselor to be allowed to approve a gender-related drug for a student without a clinician outside the school.
I want an adult in Grey County to be able to say, at a public school-board meeting, that they are seeking a gender-related medical treatment.
I want a Grey County classroom to use the name a student asks for in class, and I want that courtesy kept separate from any decision about drugs or surgery.
I want Grey County teachers to use only the name on a student's enrollment form, including when the student asks for a different name in class.

groups.title: Non-binding counts in Owen Sound
notes: A non-binding association poll is not a change to municipal election law. No bridge roles.

statements.text: I want one Owen Sound community association to run a non-binding ranked-ballot poll and to publish the ballots and the count.
I want that Owen Sound association to publish an approval count of the same ballots beside the ranked count.
I want Owen Sound municipal elections to keep first-past-the-post.
I want the Owen Sound association to refuse a ranked-ballot poll and keep its usual show of hands.
I want the Owen Sound poll to use a published counting method that a second person can rerun from the published ballots.
I want a written host kit so a second Owen Sound resident can run the next non-binding poll without the first host.
I want a one-year directory of Grey County groups that have published a non-binding ranked or approval count, including groups that stopped and the date they stopped.
